exclusions: Items already represented by canonical URL, platform ID, or content hash
Access-control bypass, private material, and unsafe non-public geodata
Precise current operational positions or targeting-enabling detail
definition_of_done: The assigned public-web discovery shard and UTC window were searched
Primary publications were preferred and upstream lineage was recorded
Canonical URLs, timestamps, language, quote locators, and access failures were recorded
Candidate source profiles and follow-up task proposals were persisted when justified

result.summary: Registered a draft profile for the official Vitali Klitschko Telegram account and two unique in-window primary updates on the overnight Kyiv attack. Existing Reuters and DSNS publications were excluded as duplicates, live target-direction warnings were excluded for safety, no binaries were captured, and two downstream task proposals were persisted.
coverage_gaps: Only two unique upstream official posts were retained after global deduplication within the narrow eleven-hour window.
Public Telegram context pages provided stable post IDs and displayed local times but no immutable captures or content hashes.

Same-day official website and infrastructure-operator indexing lagged the event, so no distinct DTEK, Ukrenergo, ministry, or municipal-operator publication with a verified in-window timestamp was retained.
Live air-defense warnings and movement-direction notices were intentionally excluded for operational safety.
No image, video, map, full-text, or other binary artifact was downloaded or hashed.
